title: How Is the Economy Doing Right Now?
author: Sigma Capital
metaDescription: The economy is generally strong with solid job growth, but inflation remains above the Fed's target. GDP growth is steady, and unemployment is low.

body: The state of the economy is generally strong, although growth has slowed, and inflation remains higher than the Fed's 2% target.
